items.description: Read protection option byte. The read protection is used to protect the software code stored in Flash memory.

values.text: Level 0, no protection
or any value other than 0xAA and 0xCC: Level 1, read protection

items.description: Selection of protection mode for nWPRi bits.

BOR OFF reset threshold level from 1.80 to 2.10 V
